tech.summary: Anthropic ne 9 November ko apne do naye models launch kiye: Claude Fable 5.2 jo sab ke liye hai (coding, reasoning, agents) aur Claude Mythos 5.2 jo sirf verified cybersecurity aur life-sciences organisations ko milega. Dono ek hi underlying model hain — Fable mein cyber aur biology safeguards zyada sakht hain. Company ke mutabiq naye models 5.1 se 30% tak tez output dete hain aur price bhi kam ho gayi hai: $8 input aur $40 output per million tokens. Launch us waqt hua hai jab Anthropic apne planned IPO se pehle OpenAI, Google aur Meta se muqabla tez kar raha hai.
tech.title: Anthropic ne Claude Fable 5.2 aur Mythos 5.2 launch kar diye — tez, sasta, aur ek sirf verified logon ke liye

tech.summary: Google ne 9 November ko apne eighth-generation TPU portfolio mein do naye systems add kar diye: TPU 8tx jo confidential inference ke liye hai — sensitive data aur model weights hardware level par protected rehte hain jab ke wo use mein hon — aur TPU 8i Max jo do TPU 8i chips ek package mein jor kar compute, SRAM aur HBM bandwidth double kar deta hai. Ye pehli dafa hai ke Google ne ek hi saal mein chaar TPU systems introduce kiye. Price ya availability date abhi announce nahi hui; systems agle saal aane ki tawaqqo hai.
tech.title: Google ne do naye TPU systems diye — 8tx secret data ke liye, 8i Max bare context ke liye

tech.summary: Nvidia ne Conference on Robot Learning (CoRL) mein GR00T 2 introduce kiya — ek open 'world action model' jo robots ko dexterous manipulation sikhata hai. Model ko 100,000 ghante ki first-person human video aur robot data par train kiya gaya. Nvidia ke tests mein GR00T 2 ne 50 mein se 40 tasks bina kisi task-specific demo ke kam az kam ek dafa complete kiye; ek demo par 71% aur paanch demos par 95% average success mili. Saath hi Isaac Lab 3.0 bhi aaya — simulation framework jisme PhysX aur Newton physics solvers switch kiye ja sakte hain. Foxconn ise server manufacturing mein aur Siemens industrial use cases mein test kar raha hai.
tech.title: Nvidia ka GR00T 2 — robot ab insaan ki video dekh kar kaam seekhega

tech.summary: Meta Superintelligence Lab ne 9 November ko Muse Ember launch kiya — Muse family ka sab se chhota aur sab se sasta model, jo agents ke roz ke repetitive kaam ke liye bana hai: tool calls, coding subtasks, routing, extraction aur lambi documents parhna. Price $0.10 per million input tokens aur $0.50 output hai, 1 million token context window ke saath. Meta ke mutabiq Ember Artificial Analysis index par Claude Haiku 5.5 ke barabar score karta hai, taqreeban aik tihai cost per task par. Model 'muse-ember-1.0' ke naam se Meta Model API aur Muse Code par live hai.
tech.title: Meta ka Muse Ember — chhota model, Haiku jitna smart, aik tihai cost

tech.summary: OpenAI ne 9 November ko elaan kiya ke ChatGPT Enterprise ab AWS Marketplace ke zariye khareeda ja sakta hai. Companies apne maujooda AWS purchasing aur billing relationship se ChatGPT Enterprise le sakti hain aur eligible kharch apne AWS commitments ki taraf count karwa sakti hain. Package mein Chat, ChatGPT Work, Codex aur dots shamil hain; OpenAI kehta hai features aur naye updates bilkul wohi milenge jo direct khareedne par milte hain. Koi public price nahi — har deal private offer par hoti hai.
tech.title: ChatGPT Enterprise ab AWS Marketplace par — bill AWS se, features wohi

pakistan.summary: Tarbela 5th Extension Hydropower Project mein peer ko Tunnel-5 ka protective bund gir gaya, jis se reservoir ka paani tunnel aur powerhouse area mein bhar gaya. Emergency declare kar ke construction muattal kar di gayi aur workers ko mehfooz jagah muntaqil kiya gaya; ek worker paani mein beh gaya tha lekin use bacha liya gaya, koi jaani nuqsan nahi hua. WAPDA ke mutabiq kamzor rock mass girne se paani andar aaya, lekin main tunnel aur powerhouse ko nuqsan nahi pahuncha. Ye 1530 MW project ka 2025 ke baad doosra bara hadsa hai — pehle cofferdam collapse par inquiry ne WAPDA, contractor aur consultant teeno ko zimmedar thehraya tha. Project ki cost Rs82.36bn se barh kar Rs317bn ho chuki hai aur completion June 2028 tak shift ho gayi hai.
pakistan.title: Tarbela-5 mein dobara hadsa — bund gir gaya, kaam band, cost Rs82bn se Rs317bn

pakistan.summary: Karachi mein Pakistani aur Saudi investors ne peer ko ek private equity fund launch kiya, jo dono mumalik ke darmiyan private sector trade aur investment ko gehra karne ki koshish ka hissa hai. Fund ka elaan us waqt hua hai jab Pakistan aur Saudi Arabia ke darmiyan economic taawun barh raha hai — pehle defence aur ab business ke maidan mein.
pakistan.title: Pakistani aur Saudi investors ne private equity fund bana liya

pakistan.summary: Pakistan ne Sri Lanka ke khilaf pehle Test ke pehle din Rawalpindi mein 281/5 bana liye. Chaar batsmen ne fifties lagayen — debutant Tayyab Arif ne 51 balls par 57, doosre debutant Mohammad Taha ne 51, captain Babar Azam ne apni 35th Test fifty (50) aur Saud Shakeel ne naqabil-e-shikast 57 banaye. Azan Awais aur Tayyab ne 86 runs ki opening partnership di. Sri Lanka ne toss jeet kar bowling chuni thi lekin un ke chaar fast bowlers ko pitch se zyada madad nahi mili; Asitha Fernando ne 2 wickets liye. Roshni kam hone par khel jaldi khatam hua — Shakeel aur Ghazi Ghori (7*) crease par hain.
pakistan.title: Rawalpindi Test, Day 1 — chaar fifties, do debutants chamke, Pakistan 281/5

pakistan.summary: Mufakkir-e-Pakistan Dr Allama Muhammad Iqbal ki 149th youm-e-pedaish par Lahore mein un ke mazar par guard ki tabdeeli ki taqreeb hui — Pakistan Navy ke dastay ne Pakistan Rangers (Punjab) se guard duties sambhal leen. Pakistan Navy Station Commander Lahore, Commodore Misbah Ul Amin, chief guest the; unhon ne Naval Chief Admiral Naveed Ashraf ki taraf se phool chadhaye aur Fateha parhi. Taqreeb mein dignitaries, media aur awam ki bari tadaad shareek hui.
pakistan.title: Iqbal Day — 149th youm-e-pedaish par Pak Navy ne mazar ki guard duties sambhali

pakistan.summary: Wazeer-e-Azam Shehbaz Sharif ne peer ko Foreign Ministry ko hidayat di ke baarish se doobe hue Gaza ke Falastiniyon ke liye insani imdad fori taur par barhayi jaye. X par apni post mein unhon ne Gaza mein kheemon ke doobne aur bachon ke bhook aur sardi mein phanse hone ki tasveeron par gehri tashweesh zahir ki aur Israeli actions ko ceasefire aur international law ki khilaf-warzi qarar de kar mazammat ki. Isi bayaan mein unhon ne China ke Shanxi province mein aag ke hadse par bhi afsos ka izhar kiya.
pakistan.title: PM Shehbaz ne Gaza ke liye imdad tez karne ka hukm diya

pakistan.summary: Deputy Prime Minister Ishaq Dar aaj Islamabad mein do rozah Margalla Dialogue 2026 ka iftatah karenge, jab ke Wazeer-e-Azam Shehbaz Sharif aaj hi Turkiye ke liye rawana ho rahe hain jahan kal Antalya mein COP31 climate summit shuru ho raha hai. Margalla Dialogue ka theme 'Global Order in Transition' hai aur is mein AI, sovereign AI aur tech risks par bhi guftagu hogi. Jumeraat se Pakistan Minerals Investment Forum bhi shuru ho raha hai — Reko Diq aur mining projects par focus, jisme Barrick, Ivanhoe Mines aur ADB ke numainde shareek honge.
pakistan.title: Margalla Dialogue aur Mineral Forum aaj se — Dar iftatah karenge, PM COP31 ke liye Turkiye ja rahe hain
